# Jewel Labs

> Hard tech for the diamond trade.

## What we build

ML automated diamond grading: software plus a physical scanning machine. A polished stone
is scanned under controlled imaging, lighting and sensing conditions. The software reads the
stone's visual and sensor signature, writes a structured fingerprint record, and converts that
into an industry-aligned grade.

The system grades across the categories that determine value: cut, colour, clarity, carat,
proportions, fluorescence, symmetry, polish, and the other optical and material signals that
separate a natural stone from a grown one.

The software can be sold standalone to businesses that already run imaging workflows. The
machine adds controlled scanning conditions, data capture and high-throughput operation.

## Throughput

A human grader evaluates one stone at a time and a high volume parcel can take days. The
machine is designed for parallel scanning at a target throughput of thousands of diamonds per
hour, turning grading from a manual bottleneck into an automated data pipeline.

## The layer above

Every scan writes a fingerprint record. A second machine learning layer reads those records and
moves the documents between houses and their agents.
